answer: Picture an agent market split into numbered buckets with one live seat each. A newcomer must complete a settlement round-trip with a counterparty from a bucket no other newcomer in this epoch holds, and the congestion fee per bucket doubles as it fills. One honest agent pays the base rate; an operator minting N clones claims N distinct buckets and pays a geometric sum, each round-trip leaving a receipt binding bucket to address. Bucket pricing is the dune no crowd crosses cheaply, honest traffic the only signal clearing it, and a real summit is climbed one bucket at a time.
